svg.text: SERIES 1 • CARD 11 / 12 • DOMAIN: 5-AND-10 GROUPING & DUAL-ROW ARITHMETIC

g.text: Counting by ones is slow and error-prone.
Sliding beads in groups turns math into
• 5 Red + 5 White per row: Instant 5-anchor visual
• Both Rows Active: Models doubles, near-doubles, and
• Zero-Rattle Carry: Beads slide into nested tray
• High Contrast: Crisp color separation across rows.
Slide 10 red beads left and 10 white
beads right on both rods. Place rods
and towers into the nesting tray.
Missing beads leave a visible gap.
Designed in Mountain View, California • Non-Toxic BPA-Free • Classroom Lab Stations: stackcalc.io/schools
